SHADOW STORMTROOPER 1/12 scale
バンダイプラモデルで再現する 黒い兵士 シャドウ・ストームトルーパー

特徴的なカラーを成形色で再現し、専用カラーの水転写式デカール・マーキングシールで細部を表現！
ポージングの幅が広がる武器、ハンドパーツ、ディスプレイベースが付属！！

en: BANDAI PLASTIC MODEL
SHADOW STORMTROOPER 1/12 scale
Black Soldier Shadow Stormtrooper reproduced with Bandai Plastic Model
Black Soldier Shadow Stormtrooper is commercialized in Bandai Star Wars Plastic Model Series 1/12 Scale.
The characteristic colors are reproduced with molded colors, and the details are expressed with special colored water transfer decals and MarkingSeals!
Includes weapons, hand parts, and a display base that expands the range of poses! !
● COLOR
The distinctive color is reproduced with a glossy black molding color.
●POSING
Each joint is movable, allowing for dynamic action poses.
●WEAPON
Comes with 3 types of weapons and holsters.
●HAND PARTS
Comes with right-handed and left-handed hand parts to support various poses.
[Accessories] □ E-11 Blaster × 1 / □ DTL-19 Heavy Blaster Rifle × 1 / □ SE-14r Short Range Combat Pistol × 1 /
□ Dedicated display base x 1□ / Hand parts x 6 types (weapon holder x 2, open hand x 2, right fist x 1, left pointing x 1) /
□ Water transfer decal ×1 / □MarkingSeal ×1
1/12 Scale Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a painted product. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
